# Products That Don't Need Production

# Products: Products That Don't Need Production

Some of the things you sell are simply handed over the counter: pens, frames, batteries, rolls of film. Nothing needs making, so there's no reason for a job to sit in production until someone remembers to mark it complete.

OrderHub lets you mark these products as needing no production. When one is sold on the Pixfizz POS till, its job is created **already completed**. If everything on the sale is like that, the order is completed and marked picked up as soon as it's paid, and the customer walks out with it.

There are three ways to set this up: for a whole category, for a single product, or for every stock-tracked product.

* Note: This only affects sales made on the Pixfizz POS till. Online orders and orders added in OrderHub are not affected.
* Note: Only new sales use your settings. Orders that already exist don't change.

---

## Option 1: A whole category

Use this when everything in a category is shelf stock, for example "Pens & Pencils" or "Film".

1. Go to **Products** → **Manage Categories**.
2. Edit the category to open **Edit POS Category**.
3. Turn on **No production needed**.
    * Note: This applies to the category's sub-categories too.
4. Click **Save**.

Categories with this switched on show a **No production** chip in the category list.

![Category - No production needed](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/46234f34-ee39-40a2-9f33-cc6e918065d0.png)

---

## Option 2: A single product

Use this for a one-off item, or to make an exception inside a category.

1. Go to **Products** and click the product's row to open it.
2. Find **Production at the till** and choose one of:

| Option | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Inherit from category/stock settings** | The default. The product follows its category and your stock setting. |
| **No production needed — complete at the till** | Always completed at the till, whatever its category says. |
| **Needs production** | Always goes to production, even in a "No production needed" category. |

3. Click **Save**.

Underneath, the **Currently:** line tells you what will happen when the product is sold, and why. For example: *Currently: completed at the till (from category 'Film')* or *Currently: goes to production*.

![A product page showing No production — handed over at the till](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/b7ea62e6-d3b7-40ed-839a-b7d37078129d.png)

* Note: Service items (such as bespoke framing) only complete at the till when set directly to **No production needed — complete at the till**. A category or stock setting never applies to them.
* Note: This setting isn't available for gift vouchers.

---

## Option 3: Every stock-tracked product

If every product you track stock for is something you hand straight over, you can switch them all on at once.

1. Go to **Settings** and open the **POS** tab.
2. In **POS Behavior**, turn on **Auto-complete tracked stock at the till**.
3. Click **Save changes**.

![Auto Complete Tracked stock at till](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/ea15ff09-2678-4e98-bdb2-383dedd410c0.png)

* Note: **POS Behavior** only appears once Pixfizz POS is enabled for your store.

---

## Which setting wins?

When a product is sold, OrderHub checks these in order and uses the first one that applies:

1. **The product's own setting**: **No production needed** or **Needs production** always wins.
2. **Its category**: if the product is in any category (or sub-category) with **No production needed** switched on.
3. **The stock setting**: if **Auto-complete tracked stock at the till** is on and the product tracks stock.
4. Otherwise, the job goes into production as normal.

**Example:** your "Film" category is set to **No production needed**, so rolls of film are handed straight over. Film developing sits in the same category but obviously needs production, so set that one product to **Needs production**.

---

## Two related POS settings

Both are in **Settings** → **POS** tab → **POS Behavior**:

* **Auto pick-up on handover** (on by default): when nothing on a paid sale needs production, the order is marked picked up straight away. Turn it off if you'd rather these orders were completed and sent to the **Pickup** queue instead.
* **Custom sales need production** (on by default): sets the starting position of the **Needs production** switch on the till's **Custom sale** screen. Staff can still change it for each item.

---

## Good to know

* **Stock is still deducted.** Completing a job at the till doesn't change how stock is counted.
* **No job tickets** are printed for items that need no production. The order summary still lists everything on the order.
* **No "your order is ready" message.** Customers aren't emailed about an order they've just been handed at the counter.
* **Mixed sales work as normal.** If a sale has shelf items and prints, the shelf items are completed straight away and the prints go into production. The order moves on, and the customer gets the usual message, when the prints are finished.
* **Pay at Pickup and partial payment aren't offered** at the till when nothing on the sale needs production, because the customer is taking everything with them.
* **Check before you sell.** The **Currently:** line on a product tells you exactly what the till will do with it.
